quote: Prompt for multi-choice tasks • Hellaswag: -"Generate the correct answer to the following question."

We evaluate three types of LLM tasks with 16 different benchmark datasets: ❶ Text Classification: SST2 , SST5 , MR , AGNews , TREC , CB (De Marneffe et al., 2019), and BoolQ . ❷ Multiple choice: Hellaswag , ARCE , PIQA , OB , ARCC , COPA , CQA . ❸ Open-ended question answering: SQuAD v1  and SQuAD v2 .
outputs: Answers to questions (e.g., multiple-choice selections or free-form responses)
The models generate answers to multiple-choice and open-ended questions, which are evaluated for accuracy and F1 score.

In this context, we employ the F1 score as the characteristic function.
